Arabic Text: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
English: I am fasting. I am fasting
pronunciation: Inneesaa'imun, 'innee saa'imun

Arabic Text: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
English: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills
pronunciation: Thahabadh-dhama'u wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-'ajru 'inshaa'Allaah.

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
English: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.
pronunciation: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka birahmatikal-latee wasi'at kulla shay'in 'an taghfira lee

Arabic Text: وَبِصَوْمِ غَدٍ نَّوَيْتُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
English: I intend to keep the fast for tomorrow in the month of Ramadan
pronunciation: Wa bisawmi ghadinn nawaiytu min shahri ramadan

Arabic Text: بِسْـمِ اللّهِ وَلَجْنـَا، وَبِسْـمِ اللّهِ خَـرَجْنـَا، وَعَلَـى رَبِّنـَا تَوَكّلْـنَا.
English: In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.
pronunciation: Bismil-lahi walajna, wabismil-lahi kharajna, waAAala rabbina tawakkalna.

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
English: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, [Generous,] You love pardon, so pardon me
pronunciation: Allahumma innaka Afuwwun [Karimun ] tuhibbul `afwa fa`fu `annee

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
English: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit , a good provision , and deeds that will be accepted.
pronunciation: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka 'ilman naafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan

Arabic Text: أعوذ بِكَلِـماتِ اللهِ التّـامَّة، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْـطانٍ وَهـامَّة، وَمِنْ كُـلِّ عَـيْنٍ لامَّـة
English: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.
pronunciation: U'eethukumaa bikalimaatil-laahit-taammati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammatin, wa min kulli 'aynin laammatin

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَآ اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَـنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
English: Our Lord! Give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and save us from the torment of the Fire!
pronunciation: Rabbanaaa Aatinaa Fiddunyaa H’asanata Wa Fil Aakhirati H’asanata Wa Qinaa A’d’aaban Naar

sub_category.name: For this world and the aakhira

Arabic Text: رَّبِّ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزٰتِ الشَّيٰطِيْنِ. وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ رَبِّ اَنْ يَّحْضُرُوْنِ
English: My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings (suggestions) of the Shayatin (devils). And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they may attend (or come near) me.
pronunciation: Rabbi ‘a`outhubika min hamazaatish-shayaateeni, wa ‘a`outhu bika rabbi ‘ay-yahdhuroon

Arabic Text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْـتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُـوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
English: In the Name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah, there is no might and no power except by Allah
pronunciation: Bismillaahi, tawakkaltu 'alallaahi, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata ‘ illaa billaah

Arabic Text: اَللَّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَعُـوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِـلَّ أَوْ أُضَـلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِـمَ أَوْ أَُظْلَـمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُـجْهَلَ عَلَـيَّ
English: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I misguide others, or I am misguided by others, lest I cause others to err or I am caused to err, lest I abuse others or be abused, and lest I behave foolishly or meet with the foolishness of others.
pronunciation: Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oothu bika 'an 'adhilla, 'aw 'udhalla, 'aw 'azilla, 'aw 'uzalla, 'aw 'adhlima, 'aw 'udhlama, 'aw 'ajhala 'aw yujhala 'alayya.

Arabic Text: لَا إلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيم، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّه رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ العَرْشِ الْكَرِيمُ
English: There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne
pronunciation: Laa 'ilaaha 'illallaahul-'Adheemul-Haleem, laa 'ilaaha 'illallaahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem, laa 'ilaaha 'illallaahu Rabbus-samaawaati wa Rabbul-'ardhi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Kareem.

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلىَ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
English: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye. Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.
pronunciation: Allaahumma rahmataka 'arjoo falaa takilnee 'ilaa nafsee tarfata 'aynin, wa 'aslih lee sha'nee kullahu, laa'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta.

Arabic Text: بسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَناَ هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَاَّ أَنْتَ
English: With the Name of Allah. Praise is to Allah. Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord we are returning. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Glory is to You. O Allah, I have wronged my own soul. Forgive me, for surely none forgives sins but You.
pronunciation: Bismillaah , Alhamdu lillaah . Subhaanal-lathee sakhkhara lanaa haathaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen. Wa 'innaa 'ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon . Alhamdu lillaah, alhamdu lillaah, alhamdu lillaah, Allaahu 'Akbar, Allaahu 'Akbar, Allaahu 'Akbar, subhaanakal-laahumma 'innee dhalamtu nafsee faghfir lee, fa'innahu laa yaghfiruth-thunooba 'illaa 'Anta.

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْـمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
English: In Your name O Allah, I live and die.
pronunciation: Bismikal-lahumma amootu wa-ahya.

Arabic Text: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
English: With Your Name my Lord, I lay myself down and with Your Name I rise. And if my soul You take, have mercy on it, and if You send it back then protect it as You protect Your righteous slaves
pronunciation: Bismika Rabbee wadha'tu janbee , wa bika 'arfa'uhu, fa'in 'amsakta nafsee farhamhaa, wa 'in 'arsaltahaa fahfadhhaa, bimaa tahfadhu bihi 'ibaadakas-saaliheen.

Arabic Text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
English: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
pronunciation: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana baAAda ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor.

Arabic Text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
English: In the name of Allah, I begin.
pronunciation: Bismillahi Wa Ala Barakatillah.

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّداً الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَاماً مَحْمُوداً الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إَنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ.
English: O Allah , Lord of this perfect call and established prayer. Grant Muhammad the intercession and favor, and raise him to the honored station You have promised him, [verily You do not neglect promises
pronunciation: Allaahumma Rabba haathid - da'watit - taammati wassalaatil-qaa'imati, 'aati Muhammadanil-waseelata walfadheelata, wab 'ath-hu maqaamam-mahmoodanil-lathee wa'adtahu, 'innaka laa tukhliful-mee'aad

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
English: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
pronunciation: Allaahum-maf taḥ lee Abwaaba Raḥmatik

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
English: O Allah, I ask You from Your favour.
pronunciation: Allaa-hum-ma innee As’aluka Min faḍ-lik

Arabic Text:
أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، 
اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
English:
I testify that there is no god but Allah, the One, there is no associate with Him and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.
O Allah! Make me among those who repent, and among those who purify themselves.
pronunciation:
Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shariika lahu, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasuuluhu,
Allahummaj'alnii minat-tawwabina waj'alni minal-mutatohhirin

Arabic Text: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلاَتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
English: I have directed my face towards the One who has created the heavens and the earth, as a Hanif, and I am not of the idolaters. Indeed, my Salat, my sacrifice, my living, my dying, is for Allah, the Lord of all that exists, without partner, and with this have I been ordered and I am of the Muslims
pronunciation: wajjahtu wajhiya lil-ladhee faṭarad-samaawaati wal-arḍa ḥaneefan, wa maa ana minal-mushrikeen, inna ṣalaatee wa nusukee wa maḥyaa-ya wa mamaatee lillaahi rabbil-‛aalameena, laa shareeka lahu wa bidhaalika umirtu wa ana minal-muslimeen

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ، كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَ بْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْمَاءِ وَالْبَرَدِ
English: O Allah , separate me from my sins as You have separated the East from the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my transgressions as the white garment is cleansed of stains . O Allah , wash away my sins with ice and water and frost.
pronunciation: Allaahumma baa’id baynee wa bayna khataayaaya kamaa baa’adta baynal-mashriqi walmaghribi, Allaahumma naqqinee min khataayaaya kamaa yunaqqath-thawbul-‘abyadhu minad-danasi, Allaahum-maghsilnee min khataayaaya, bith-thalji walmaa’i walbarad

Arabic Text: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
English: Glory to my Lord the Exalted.
pronunciation: Subhaana Rabbiyal-'Adheem

Arabic Text: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
English: Glory is to You , O Allah , our Lord , and praise is Yours . O Allah , forgive me.
pronunciation: Subhaanaka Allaahumma Rabbanaa wa bihamdika Allaahum-maghfir lee

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏
English: O Allah, our Lord, to You be the Praise, filling the heavens, filling the Earth, and filling whatever else You will.
pronunciation: Allahumma, Rabbana wa lakal-hamd, mil'as-samawati wa mil'al-ardi wa mil'ama shi'ta min shai'in ba'd

Arabic Text: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى
English: Glory is to my Lord, the Most High.
pronunciation: Subhaana Rabbiyal-A 'laa

Arabic Text: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
English: Glory is to You , O Allah , our Lord , and praise is Yours . O Allah , forgive me.
pronunciation: Subhaanaka Allaahumma Rabbanaa wa bihamdika Allaahum-maghfir lee

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
English: O Allah forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, support me, protect me, provide for me and elevate me.
pronunciation: Allaahum-maghfir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wajburnee, wa 'aafinee, warzuqnee, warfa'nee

Arabic Text: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
English: All the best compliments and the prayers and the good things are for Allah. Peace and Allah’s Mercy and Blessings be on you, O Prophet! Peace be on us and on the pious slaves of Allah, I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and I also testify that Muhammad is Allah’s slave and His Apostle.
pronunciation: Attahiyat lillahi wa salawatu wa’t-tayyibat, as-salamu ‘alayka ayyuha’n-Nabiyyu wa rahmat-Allahi wa barakatuhu. As-salamu ‘alayna wa ‘alaa ‘ibad-Illah is-saliheen. ashhadu alla ilaha illallah wa ashhadu anna muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasuluhu

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
English: O Allah, bestow Your favor on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad as You have bestowed Your favor on Ibrahim and on the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You have blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.
pronunciation: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa 'aali Muhammadin, kamaa sallayta 'alaa 'Ibraaheema wa 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema, 'innaka Hameedun Majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa 'aali Muhammadin, kamaa baarakta 'alaa 'Ibraaheema wa 'alaa 'aali 'Ibraaheema, 'innaka Hameedun Majeed

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلهَ إِلَاَّ أَنْتَ
English: Allah, forgive me what I have sent before me and what I have left behind me, what I have concealed and what I have done openly, what I have done in excess , and what You are better aware of than I . You are the One Who sends forth and You are the One Who delays . There is none worthy of worship but You.
pronunciation: Allaahum-maghfir lee maa qaddamtu, wa maa ‘akhkhartu, wa maa ‘asrartu, wa maa ‘a’lantu, wa maa ‘asraftu, wa maa ‘Anta ‘a’lamu bihi minnee. ‘Antal-Muqaddimu, wa ‘Antal-Mu’akhkhiru laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أعُوذُ بكَ مِن عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، ومِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ، ومِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَحْيَا والمَمَاتِ، ومِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ.
English: O Allah, I seek refuge with you from the torture of the grave, the torture of Hellfire, the seditions of life and death, and from the sedition of the Imposter Masih.
pronunciation: Allahumma ini a`udhu bika min 'adhabi-l-Qabr, wa min 'adhabi-nnar, wa min fitnati-l-mahya wa-lmamat, wa min fitnati-l-masih ad-dajjal.

Arabic Text:
اللهم  أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ ‏
لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيءٍ قًدِيرٌ‏.‏ اَللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
English:
O Allah, You are As-Salam (Peace), From You is all peace, blessed are You O Possessor of majesty and honour.
There is no true god except Allah. He is One and He has no partner with Him, His is the sovereignty and His is the praise, and He is Omnipotent. O Allah! None can deny that which You bestow and none can bestow that which You hold back, and the greatness of the great will be of no avail to them against You.
pronunciation:
Allāhumma Antas-Salām wa minkas-salām. Tabārakta yā Zal-jalāli wal- ikrām.
Lā ilāha illallāhu wahdahu lā syarika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'alā kulli shay-in Qadir. Allāhumma lā māni'a limā a'tayta, wa lā mu'tiya limā mana'ta, wa lā yanfa'u zal-jaddi minkal-jaddu.

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
English: English: O Allah, help me to remember You and thank You and help me to the best manner of worshipping You. [10
pronunciation: Allahumma a’innee alaa dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni ‘ibaadatika

Arabic Text: بِسْمِ الله اَوَّلَهُ وَاخِرَهُ
English: In the name of Allah in its beginning and end.
pronunciation: Bismillahi Awwalahu Wa aakhirahu.

Arabic Text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
English: All praise belongs to Allah, who fed us and quenched our thirst, and made us Muslims.
pronunciation: Alhamdu Lillah-hil Lazi Aat’aamana Wasakana Wa-ja-aa lana Minul-Muslimin

Arabic Text: اﻟﻠَّﻬُﻢَّ ﺇِﻧِّﻲ ﺃَﻋُﻮﺫُ ﺑِﻚَ ﻣِﻦَ اﻟْﻬَﻢِّ ﻭَاﻟْﺤَﺰَﻥِ، ﻭَﺃَﻋُﻮﺫُ ﺑِﻚَ ﻣِﻦَ اﻟْﻌَﺠْﺰِ ﻭَاﻟْﻜَﺴَﻞِ، ﻭَﺃَﻋُﻮﺫُ ﺑِﻚَ ﻣِﻦَ اﻟْﺠُﺒْﻦِ ﻭَاﻟْﺒُﺨْﻞِ، ﻭَﺃَﻋُﻮﺫُ ﺑِﻚَ ﻣِﻦْ ﻏَﻠَﺒَﺔِ اﻟﺪَّﻳْﻦِ، ﻭَﻗَﻬْﺮِ اﻟﺮِّﺟَﺎﻝِ
English: “O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men.”
pronunciation: Allahumma inni a’udhu bika minal-hammi wal-Ḥuzni wal-’ajazi wal-kasli wal-bukhli wal-jubni wa ḍala’id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
English: O Allah, grant us blessing in it and give us more of it.
pronunciation: Allahumma Baarik Lanaa Feehi Wa-Zidnaa minhu.

Arabic Text: اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُبِكَ أَنْ أُشْـرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنا أَعْـلَمْ، وَأَسْتَـغْفِرُكَ لِما لا أَعْـلَم
English: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.
pronunciation: Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oothu bika 'an 'ushrika bika wa 'anaa 'a'lamu, wa 'astaghfiruka limaa laa 'a'lamu

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
English: O Allah, I seek refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.
pronunciation: Allaahumma innee A‛oozu Bika Minal-khubuthi wal-khabaa’ith.

Arabic Text: غُفْرَانَكَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنِّي الْأَذَى وَعَافَانِي
English: (O Allah) I seek forgiveness and pardon from You, All Praise be to Allah, who removed the difficulty from me and gave me ease (relief).
pronunciation: Ghuf-raa naka, Alhamdulillah-hilla-zee Az-haba Ann-nil azaa Wa ‘afaani.

sub_category.name: After Coming out of the Toilet

Arabic Text: بِسْمِ اللهِ ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
English: “In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah and there is no might nor power except with Allah.”
pronunciation: Bismillaah, Tawakkaltu ‛Alal-laah, wa laa ḥawla wa laa quwwata illaa Billaah

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلِجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
English: O Allah, I seek a good entry and a good exit. We take Allah’s name to enter and to exit and rely on Him who is our Lord.
pronunciation: Allaahumma innee As’aluka khairal Maulegi wa khariral makhregi, Bismillaahi walajnaa, wa Lallhi Rab-binaa Tawak-kalnaa.

Arabic Text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
English: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without a partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He Omnipotent over all things.
pronunciation: Laa ilaaha ill-allaahu Waḥdahu Laa Shareeka lah, Lah-ul-mulku Wa lahul-ḥamdu, Yuḥyee Wa yumeetu Wa huwa ḥayun Laa yamootu, Bi yadi-hil-khayru, Wa huwa ‛alaa Kulli shay’in Qadeer

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
English: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
pronunciation: Allaahum-maf taḥ lee Abwaaba Raḥmatik

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
English: O Allah, I ask You from Your favour.
pronunciation: Allaa-hum-ma innee As’aluka Min faḍ-lik

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ كَمَا أَنْتَ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
English: O Allah as you have given me a good physical form, so also favour me with good morals and manners.
pronunciation: Allahumma Kama Hasanta khalqi Fahassin Khuluqi

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا ، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
English: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.
pronunciation: Allaahumma Laa Sahla illaa Maa Ja‛altahu Sahlan, Aa anta Taj‛al-ul-ḥazna izaa Shi’ta Sahlan

Arabic Text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلَاً
English: All praise belongs to Allah who has saved me from such a condition which is afflicted on you and favoured me over many of his creations.
pronunciation: Al-ḥamdu Lil-laahil-ladhzee, Aafaanee Mim-mab-ta-laaka Bih, Wa faḍ-ḍala-nee, Alaa kasee-rim mim man khalaqa Taf-ḍeelaa

Arabic Text: الحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
English: All praise belongs to Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.
pronunciation: alḥamdu Lillaahil-lazee Kasaanee Haazas-sauwba Wa razaqaneehi Min Ghayri Hawlin Minnee Wa laa Quwwah

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَه، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
English: O Allah, all praise is to You, just as You have dressed me, I ask You for the good of it and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of it and the evil for which it was made.
pronunciation: Allaahumma Lakal-ḥamdu Anta kasawtaneehi, As’aluka Min Khayrihi Wa khayri Maa Suni‛a lahu, Wa ’a‛oozu Bika Min Sharrihi Wa sharri Maa suni‛a lah

Arabic Text: اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
English: “I seek refuge in Al’laah from Shaitaan the cursed”
pronunciation: “A’oozu Bil’laahi Minash Shaitaanir Rajeem”

Arabic Text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ، سُـبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّـرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنّا لَهُ مُقْـرِنين وَإِنّا إِلى رَبِّنا لَمُنـقَلِبُون
English: Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. "How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this (transport) at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny.”
pronunciation: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, allahu akbar, Subhanal-ladzi sakh-khara lana hadza wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin. Wa inna ila Rabbina lamun-qalibun.

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا  تَرْضَى ، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ.
English:
O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and God-consciousness (Taqwa) in this journey of ours, and we ask You (to enable us) for deeds that please You,
O Allah, ease our journey and shorten its distance quickly. O Allah, You are The Companion on this journey and The Successor in our family (left behind)
O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the difficulties of travel and being in a bad predicament, and I take refuge in You from returning to a bad outcome concerning wealth and family.
pronunciation: Allahumma inna nas’aluka fi safarina hatha al-birra wat-taqwa wa minal-‘amali ma tardha. Allahumma hawwin ‘alayna safarana haatha, watwi ‘anna bu‘dahu. Allahumma anta As-Saahibu fissafar, wal-Khaleefatu fil’ahl, Allahumma inni a‘oothu bika min wa‘thaa’is-safar, wa ka’aabatil-manthar, wa soo’il-munqalabi fil-maali wal-’ahli

Arabic Text: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى وَغَفَرَ لَكَ ذَنْبَكَ وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كُنْتَ
English: "May Allah make piety part of your journey, forgive your sins and fulfil the purpose of the journey".
pronunciation: ZawwadakAllahut taqwa, wa ghafara dhanbak’.  wa yassara lakal khayra haythuma kunta

sub_category.name: For Another Person Undertaken a Journey

Arabic Text: أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
English: I ask You for the goodness of this town, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I seek refuge with You from the evil of this town, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.
pronunciation: as’aluka khayra haadhi-hil-qaryati wa khayra ahlihaa wa khayra maa feehaa, wa a‛oodhu bika min sharrihaa wa sharri ahlihaa wa sharri maa feehaa

sub_category.name: When Arriving at a City or Destination

Arabic Text: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
English: We return, we repent, we worship and we praise our Lord.
pronunciation: Aayiboon, taa’iboon, ‘aabidoona, li-Rabbina haamidoon

Arabic Text: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَ بِسْمِ اللهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
English: In the Name of Allah we enter, in the Name of Allah we leave, and we depend on our Lord
pronunciation: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'alaRabblna tawakkalna

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِني ، وسَدِّدْنِي
English: O Allah! Guide me and grant me uprightness
pronunciation: Allaahummah-dinee wa saddidnee

Arabic Text: اللَّهمَّ إنِّي أسْألُكَ الهُدَى والسَّدَادَ
English: O Allah! Verily,I beg You for guidance and uprightness
pronunciation: Allahumma inni as’aluk-al-huda was-sadad

Arabic Text:
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ

فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ ،

اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ (هَذَا الأَمْرَ) خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ، فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ

وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ (هَذَا الأَمْرَ) شَرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ، فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
English:
O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and by Your power I seek strength and I ask You from Your immense favour,
For indeed You are able while I am not and You know while I do not and You are the Knower of the unseen.
O Allah, if You know (this affair) - or you may mention your need now - to be good for me in relation to my religion, my life, and end, then decree and facilitate it for me, and bless me with it,
And if You know this affair to be ill for me in my religion, my life, and my end, then remove it from me and remove me from it, and decree for me what whatever is good wherever it may be and make me satisfied with it.
pronunciation:
allaahumma innee astakheeruka bi-‛ilmik, wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratik, wa as’aluka min faḍlik-al-‛aẓeem,

fa innaka taqdiru wa laa aqdir, wa ta‛lamu wa laa a‛lam, wa anta ‛allaam-ul-ghuyoob,

allaahumma in kunta ta‛lamu anna (haadhal-amra) khayrun lee fee deenee wa ma‛aashee wa ‛aaqibati amree, faqdurhu lee wa yassirhu lee, thumma baarik lee feeh,

wa in kunta ta‛lamu anna (haadhal-amra) sharrun lee fee deenee wa ma‛aashee wa ‛aaqibati amree, faṣrifhu ‛annee waṣ-rifnee ‛anhu waqdur liyal-khayra ḥaythu kaana, thumma arḍinee bih

Arabic Text: اللّهُمَّ اكْفِني بِحَلالِكَ عَنْ حَرامِك، وَأَغْنِني بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِواك
English: “O Allaah! Provide me with lawful (Halal) livelihood, adequate to my needs instead of the unlawful (Haram), and make me suffice with Your graces needing nothing from anyone else”
pronunciation:
Allaahumma akfini bi halallika ‘an haraamika,
wa aghnini bi fadlika ‘amman siwaka

Arabic Text: اﻟﻠَّﻬُﻢَّ ﺇِﻧِّﻲ ﺃَﻋُﻮﺫُ ﺑِﻚَ ﻣِﻦَ اﻟْﻬَﻢِّ ﻭَاﻟْﺤَﺰَﻥِ، ﻭَﺃَﻋُﻮﺫُ ﺑِﻚَ ﻣِﻦَ اﻟْﻌَﺠْﺰِ ﻭَاﻟْﻜَﺴَﻞِ، ﻭَﺃَﻋُﻮﺫُ ﺑِﻚَ ﻣِﻦَ اﻟْﺠُﺒْﻦِ ﻭَاﻟْﺒُﺨْﻞِ، ﻭَﺃَﻋُﻮﺫُ ﺑِﻚَ ﻣِﻦْ ﻏَﻠَﺒَﺔِ اﻟﺪَّﻳْﻦِ، ﻭَﻗَﻬْﺮِ اﻟﺮِّﺟَﺎﻝِ
English: “O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts, and from being overpowered by men.”
pronunciation: Allahumma inni a’udhu bika minal-hammi wal-Ḥuzni wal-’ajazi wal-kasli wal-bukhli wal-jubni wa ḍala’id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.

Arabic Text: لا بأْسَ طَهـورٌ إِنْ شـاءَ الله
English: Do not worry, it will be a purification (for you), if Allah will
pronunciation: Laa ba sa tahoorun inshaa Allaah.

Arabic Text: (7 x)  أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ العَظِيْمَ، رَبَّ العَرْشِ العَظِيْمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيْكَ
English: ‘I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’. (7 times)
pronunciation: as’alullaah-al-‛aẓeema rabbal-‛arshil-‛aẓeemi an yashfeek (x 7)

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِب الْبَأسَ، واشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافي، لا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفاءً لا يُغَادِرُ سقَمًا
English: Oh Allah, the Lord of the people! Remove the trouble and heal him (i.e. the sick person) for You are the Healer. No healing is of any avail but Yours; healing that will leave behind no ailment
pronunciation: Allaahumma rabbin naas, adh`hibil ba’s, ishfihi antash shaafi, laa shifaa’a illaa shifaauk, shifaa’an laa yughaadiru saqamaa

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
English: O Allah, just as you had perfected my creation, [also] perfect my [moral] character
pronunciation: allaahumma kamaa ḥassanta khalqee fa ḥassin khuluqee

Arabic Text: اللَّهمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن منْكَرَاتِ الأَخلاقِ، والأعْمَالِ، والأَهْواءِ‏
English: O Allah! I seek refuge in You from reprehensible conduct, deeds and desires.
pronunciation: Allaahumma ‘innee a’oothu bika min munkaraatil-akhlaaqi, wal-a’maali, wal– ‘ahwaa

Arabic Text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
English: In the name of Allah
pronunciation: Bismillah

Arabic Text: بِسْمِ الله اَوَّلَهُ وَاخِرَهُ
English: In the name of Allah in it’s beginning and end
pronunciation: Bismillahi Awwalahu Wa aakhirahu

Arabic Text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
English: All praise belongs to Allah, who fed us and quenched our thirst and made us Muslims
pronunciation: Alhamdu Lillah-hil Lazi Aat’aamana Wasakana Wa-ja-aa lana Minul-Muslimin

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
English: O Allah, grant us blessing in it and give us more of it.
pronunciation: Allahumma Baarik Lanaa Feehi Wa-Zidnaa minhu.

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
English: “Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.” [Quran; 25:74]
pronunciation: rabbana hab lana min azwajina wathurriyyatina qurrata aAAyunin waijAAalna lilmuttaqeena imaman

Arabic Text: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
English: "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.” (Quran: 17:24)
pronunciation: Rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayanee sagheera

Arabic Text: اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَدَنـي ، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في سَمْـعي ، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَصَـري ، لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ. اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُبِكَ مِنَ الْكُـفر ، وَالفَـقْر ، وَأَعـوذُبِكَ مِنْ عَذابِ القَـبْر ، لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ
English: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, preserve for me my hearing. O Allah, preserve for me my sight. There is none worthy of worship but You . O Allah , I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave . There is none worthy of worship but You.
pronunciation: Allaahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta. Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oothu bika minal-kufri, walfaqri, wa 'a'oothu bika min 'adhaabil-qabri, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta.

Arabic Text: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الأَبْرَارُ ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ
English: "May the fasting (people) break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angels send prayers upon you."
pronunciation: afṭara ‛indakum-uṣ-ṣaa’imoona wa akala ṭa‛aamakum-ul-abraaru, wa ṣallat ‛alaykum-ul-malaa’ikah

sub_category.name: When breaking fast in someone's home

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً، غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
English: O Allah, shower upon us abundant rain, beneficial not harmful, swiftly and not delayed.
pronunciation: Allaahumma 'asqinaa ghaythan mugheethan maree'an maree'an, naafi'an ghayradhaarrin, 'aajilan ghayra 'aajilin.

Arabic Text: اللّهُمَّ صَيِّـباً نافِـعاً
English: O Allah, (bring) beneficial rain clouds.
pronunciation: Allaahumma sayyiban naafi an

Arabic Text: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللهِ وَ رَحْمَتِهِ
English: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
pronunciation: Mutirnaa bifadhlillaahi wa rahmatihi.

Arabic Text: اللّهُـمَّ إِنَّـي أَسْـأَلُـكَ خَيْـرَها، وَخَيْـرَ ما فيهـا، وَخَيْـرَ ما اُرْسِلَـتْ بِه، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّها، وَشَـرِّ ما فيهـا، وَشَـرِّ ما اُرْسِلَـتْ بِه
English: O Allah, I ask You for the good of it, for the good of what it contains, and for the good of what is sent with it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of it, from the evil of what it contains, and from the evil that is sent with it.
pronunciation: Allaahumma innee as aluka khayrahaa, wa khayra maa feehaa, wa khayra maa ursilat bihi wa a oothu bika min sharrihaa, wa sharri maa feehaa, wa sharri maa ursilat bihi.

Arabic Text: سُبْـحانَ الّذي يُسَبِّـحُ الـرَّعْدُ بِحَمْـدِهِ، وَالملائِكـةُ مِنْ خيـفَته
English: Glory is to Him Whom thunder and angels glorify due to fear of Him
pronunciation: Subhaanal-lathee yusabbihur-ra du bihamdihi walmalaa ikatu min kheefatihi.

Arabic Text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
English: O Allah , I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.
pronunciation: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-jannata wa 'a'oothu bika minan-naar

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِیعُ العَلِیمُ
English: “Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.” – 2:127 –
pronunciation: Rabbana taqabbal minnaa innaka Antas Samee’ul Aleem

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَآ آتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
English: “Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” – 2:201 –
pronunciation: Rabbana atina fid dunyaa hasanatanw wa fil aakhirati hasanatanw wa qinaa azaaban Naar

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَیْنَا صَبْراً وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى القَوْمِ الكَافِرِینَ
English: “Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.” – 2:250 –
pronunciation: Rabbana afrigh ‘alainaa sabranw wa sabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa ‘alal qawmil kaafireen

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
English: “Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred.”
pronunciation: Rabbana laa tu’aakhiznaaa in naseenaaa aw akhtaanaa

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا
English: “Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.”
pronunciation: Rabbana wa laa tahmil-‘alainaaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo ‘alal-lazeena min qablinaa

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
English: “Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.”
pronunciation: Rabbana wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih; wa’fu ‘annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa; Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa ‘alal qawmil kaafireen

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا لاَ تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ ھَدَیْتَنَا وَھَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَھَّابُ
English: “Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.” – 3:8 –
pronunciation: Rabbana laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba’da iz hadaitanaa wa hab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah; innaka antal Wahhaab

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا  وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
English: “Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire” – 3:16 -
pronunciation: Rabbanaaa innanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa qinaa ‘azaaban Naar

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰھِدِینَ
English: “Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger [i.e., Jesus], so register us among the witnesses [to truth].” – 3:53 –
pronunciation: Rabbanaaa aamannaa bimaaa anzalta wattaba’nar Rasoola faktubnaa ma’ash shaahideen

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِىٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
English: Rabbanagh fir lanaa zunoobanaa wa israafanaa feee amrinaa wa sabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa ‘alal qawmil kaafireen – 3:147 –
pronunciation: Rabbanagh fir lanaa zunoobanaa wa israafanaa feee amrinaa wa sabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa ‘alal qawmil kaafireen

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَیِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ
English: “Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die among the righteous.”
pronunciation: Rabbanaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa kaffir ‘annaa saiyi aatina wa tawaffanaa ma’al abraar

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
English: “Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.” – 7:23 –
pronunciation: Rabbanaa zalamnaaa anfusanaa wa illam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal khaasireen

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا لاَ تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِینَ
English:
“Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.”
– 7:47
pronunciation: Rabbanaa laa taj’alnaa ma’al qawmiz zaalimeen

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
English: “Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].”
pronunciation: Rabbanaaa afrigh ‘alainaa sabranw wa tawaffanaa muslimeen

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِینَ یَوْمَ یَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
English: “Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.”
pronunciation: Rabbanagh fir lee wa liwaalidaiya wa lilmu’mineena Yawma yaqoomul hisaab

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَآ ءَتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
English: “Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.” – 18:10 –
pronunciation: Rabbanaaa aatinaa mil ladunka rahmatanw wa haiyi’ lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا ھَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّیَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْیُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِینَ إِمَامًا
English:
“Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous.”
– 25:74 –
pronunciation: Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyaatinaa qurrata a’yuninw waj ‘alnaa lilmuttaqeena Imaamaa

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِیرٌ
English: “Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.” – 66:8 –
pronunciation: Rabbanaaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lana innaka ‘alaa kulli shai’in qadeer

Arabic Text: رَّبَّنَا عَلَیْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَیْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَیْكَ الْمَصِیرُ
English:
“Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.”
– 60:4 –
pronunciation: Rabbanaa ‘alaika tawakkalnaa wa ilaika anabnaa wa ilaikal maseer

Arabic Text: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا
English:
“Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed.”
– 59:10
pronunciation: Rabbanagh fir lanaa wa li ikhwaani nal lazeena sabqoonaa bil eemaani wa laa taj’al fee quloobinaa ghillalil lazeena aamanoo

Arabic Text: اَلّلهُمَّ أنْتَ رَبِّيْ لَا اِلهَ اِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِيْ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ اَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ ذُنُوْبِىْ فَإِنَّه لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ إلَّا أَنْتَ
English: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You have created me and I am Your slave and I am keeping my promise and covenant to You as much as I can. I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I do. I acknowledge Your blessing and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for there is none who can forgive sin except You
pronunciation: Allahumma anta Rabbii laa ilaaha illaa anta, Khalaq-tanii wa ana ‘Abduka, wa ana a’la a’hdika wa wa’dika mastata’tu, a’udhu bika min sharri maa sana’tu, abuo-u laka bini’matika a’laiya, wa abuo-u laka bidhanbii faghfirli, fa innahuo laa yaghfiru-dhunouba illaa anta.”

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلِجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
English: O Allah, I seek a good entry and a good exit. We take Allah’s name to enter and  and rely on Him who is our Lord.
pronunciation: Allaahumma innee As’aluka khairal Maulegi wa khariral makhregi, Bismillaahi walajnaa, wa Lallhi Rab-binaa Tawak-kalnaa.

Arabic Text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
English: Translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your favour.
pronunciation: Allaa-hum-ma innee As’aluka Min faḍ-lik

Arabic Text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا الطَّعَامَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
English: "All Praise belongs to Allah who granted this meal, (which I received) without my power or effort".
pronunciation: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'at'amani hadha, wa razaqanihi, min ghayri hawlin minnee wa la quwwatin.

Arabic Text: اللّهُمَّ حَوالَيْنا وَلا عَلَيْـنَا، اللّهُمَّ عَلى الآكَـامِ وَالظِّـرابِ، وَبُطُـونِِ الأوْدِيةِ، وَمَنـابِِتِ الشَّجَـرِ
English: O Allah, let it pass us and not fall upon us, but upon the hills and mountains, and the center of the valleys, and upon the forested lands
pronunciation: Allaahumma hawaalaynaa wa laa 'alaynaa. Allaahumma 'alal-'aakaami wadh-dhiraabi, wa butoonil-'awdiyati, wa manaabitish-shajari

Arabic Text: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
English: Guide us along the straight path.
pronunciation: Ihdinas-Siraatal-Mustaqeem
